content.text: Search's CPU rose from about 0.007 to 2.7 cores, but its own span time fell, and its errors are explicitly "failed to get nearby hotels from geo service". I'll treat the CPU as a symptom of the failing geo calls, not a separate fault. I'll confirm the failure path with trace queries.
